Club pays for a coaching tool

Reeplayer

Los Angeles, California, United States · founded 2021 · active · www.reeplayer.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolPortable unitNo Italian presence foundEvidence B€500 to €2,000 to start

Reeplayer sells a US made three lens soccer camera with on device AI and a built in SIM for USD 1,499 plus USD 99 a month, streams every game live for free, and since July 2026 offers to give teams the camera when a local brand sponsors it reeplayer-01, reeplayer-05.

For American youth and amateur soccer teams that want instant livestreams and quick uploads without a parent managing hotspots or ethernet cables, and club directors willing to try an advertising funded camera reeplayer-01, reeplayer-06. The company states it is available only in the United States and only for soccer reeplayer-01, reeplayer-03.

Reeplayer exists because a Los Angeles founding team decided the cure for slow uploads and dead hotspots was a camera with its own cellular modem and an NVIDIA Jetson doing the AI on the sideline, and it raised USD 10 million in 2023 to build that in Pittsburgh reeplayer-08, reeplayer-10. It matters now because the July 2026 End Pay-to-Play initiative tries to move the bill from families to brands, with 40% of advertising profit returned to the team, which is the first serious attempt in this market to turn the camera from a cost into a media asset reeplayer-05, reeplayer-06. It tells you that whoever controls the livestream of youth games controls an audience, and that vendors are starting to price accordingly.

Price band USD 1,499 camera + USD 349 tripod one off, plus USD 1,188/yr (USD 99/month billed annually) or USD 2,700 per three years; sponsor funded option at USD 0 to the team where a brand signs reeplayer-01

Italy Reeplayer states the product is exclusively available in the United States and the built in data plan is tied to US carriers, so there is no Italian or European availability reeplayer-01, reeplayer-03.

Premium edition: the verdict (look if, skip if, watch-outs), the profile against 24 criteria, the verified price list per market and the company block are in the premium edition. Ask for access.

Products

  • Reeplayer AI camera (camera). Three Sony sensor panoramic camera with NVIDIA Jetson edge AI, built in SIM, WiFi, about 4 hours battery and 30 games of local storage, made in Pittsburgh reeplayer-08, reeplayer-04.
  • Reeplayer app and viewer platform (platform). Unlimited teams and users, free livestream links, instant playback, MP4 downloads, tagging, comments and player profiles reeplayer-04.
  • End Pay-to-Play (add-on). Sponsor funded camera programme launched July 2026 with exclusive brand advertising on a team's stream and 40% of advertising profits returned to the team reeplayer-05, reeplayer-06.

Scale, company-stated

Hundreds of systems deployed and thousands of games captured, per Hellbender reeplayer-08. Four sponsored teams committed and about a dozen brand pilots over the prior year, July 2026 reeplayer-05. Crunchbase lists 1 to 10 employees reeplayer-09.

2025 and 2026

  • 2025-10-13: Reeplayer publishes a three year cost comparison claiming USD 5,063 against Veo and Trace reeplayer-10.
  • 2026-07-25: End Pay-to-Play initiative announced with first sponsor and August 2026 camera launch reeplayer-05.

Not verified

  • Camera output resolution and frame rate.
  • Number of active customers and current headcount.
  • Whether the first sponsored cameras shipped in August 2026 as planned.
  • Livestream latency and the definition of advertising profit behind the 40% team share.
  • Footage retention after cancellation and consent practices for sponsored streams of minors.
  • Any plan to sell outside the United States.
